_meta.description: Synthetic product usage analytics for the Product Discovery Agent demo. All metrics are fabricated and illustrative only; they do not represent a real product.

dark_mode.metric_area: session behavior by time of day
usage_patterns: 22% of total sessions occur between 8pm and 6am local time.
Evening sessions (8pm-6am) average 6.4 minutes vs 9.1 minutes for daytime sessions.
accessibility_signals: Support tickets tagged 'eye strain' or 'brightness' rose 14% quarter-over-quarter.
3 tickets explicitly referenced light sensitivity or migraine triggers.
trends: Evening session abandonment has increased slightly over the last two quarters.
data_limitations: Higher evening abandonment is correlational, not causal - it may reflect fatigue, device switching, or notification interruptions rather than screen brightness.
The analytics system does not currently capture ambient lighting or device brightness settings.
Sample size for night-time sessions is smaller than daytime, widening the confidence interval on these figures.

usage_patterns: Mobile web sessions account for 16% of total traffic, up from 9% a year ago.
Mobile web users complete core workflows at roughly half the rate of desktop users.
accessibility_signals: Tap target size complaints appear in 5 support tickets over the last quarter.
trends: Mobile web traffic share has grown steadily for four consecutive quarters.
data_limitations: Mobile web abandonment may reflect a poorly responsive layout rather than proof that a native app is needed.
No data currently distinguishes iOS vs Android usage patterns.
Analytics cannot separate intentional short visits (quick lookups) from true task abandonment.

usage_patterns: 68% of recorded calls have no linked notes or follow-up task within 48 hours.
Teams with more than 10 recorded calls per week show the lowest note-completion rate.
accessibility_signals: No direct accessibility signals identified for this feature area.
trends: Recorded call volume has grown 40% year-over-year, increasing the manual note-taking burden.
data_limitations: Missing follow-up notes could reflect note-taking happening outside the product (e.g., in email or a separate tool), not necessarily a lack of need.
The analytics system cannot verify note quality, only presence or absence of a linked note.

usage_patterns: Only 44% of new accounts complete core setup within the first 7 days.
Accounts that don't complete setup within 7 days churn at 3x the rate of those that do.
accessibility_signals: No direct accessibility signals identified for this feature area.
trends: Setup completion rate has been flat for three consecutive quarters despite other product improvements.
data_limitations: The funnel data shows where users drop off but not definitively why - qualitative research would be needed to confirm root cause.
Some 'incomplete setup' accounts may be low-intent trials rather than genuinely blocked users.

usage_patterns: The browser print dialog is triggered from report pages roughly 900 times per month.
CSV export is used 3x more often than print, suggesting demand for offline formats generally.
accessibility_signals: No direct accessibility signals identified for this feature area.
trends: Print dialog usage from report pages has been stable for two quarters.
data_limitations: Print dialog usage is a proxy signal for offline/sharing demand, not direct evidence that a formatted PDF export is required.
The analytics system cannot tell whether print attempts succeeded or produced usable output.
